notes.md: - **AP at the 20th NCeG (Visakhapatnam, 9-10 Jan 2017):** AP won **Gold** for the **Aadhaar-enabled PDS** (Civil Supplies) in citizen-centric service delivery and **Gold** for the **Loan Charge Creation** project (land administration, Vijayawada) in process re-engineering.

- **Jawahar Knowledge Centres (JKC):** AP government human-resource initiative that trains college students in technical and soft skills for employability; run by the **Institute for Electronic Governance (IEG)**, a society under the **IT&C Department**.

new.s: Which section of the Information Technology Act, 2000 gives legal recognition to digital signatures?
new.x: Section 5 treats electronic (digital) signatures like handwritten ones; Section 4 covers electronic records.

new.s: Which section of the IT Act, 2000 says that no one can insist that a government document be accepted in electronic form?

new.s: What is the name of the newer version of Andhra Pradesh's CARD registration system, introduced in September 2023?

new.s: Which law provides time-bound delivery of notified services in Andhra Pradesh?
o: AP Public Services Delivery Guarantee Act, 2017
AP Right to Public Services Act, 2011

new.s: Within what time must the First Appellate Authority ordinarily decide a first appeal under the RTI Act?
new.x: A first appeal is filed within 30 days and decided within 30 days, extendable to 45 days.
new.angle: U0364 notes gap: First appeal decided in 30 (max 45) days

new.s: Who appoints the State Chief Information Commissioner?
o: Chief Justice of the High Court
new.x: Under Section 15 the Governor appoints the State CIC and SICs on the recommendation of a committee chaired by the CM.
new.angle: U0364 notes gap: SIC appointed by Governor

new.s: Which Section of the RTI Act, 2005 provides for the constitution of State Information Commissions?

new.s: Under Section 3 of the RTI Act, who has the right to information?

new.x: Section 3 gives the right to every citizen; only citizens can apply.
new.angle: U0364 notes gap: Section 3 citizens only

new.s: While inquiring into complaints, the Central and State Information Commissions have the powers of which body?

new.s: Under the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013, at least half of the Lokpal members must come from which groups?
